title: Jacob's Woodcutter
description: A smoother, cleaner woodcutter that works without unnecessary items, only the essentials.
body:
![2K Banner](https://i.imgur.com/c38zURI.png) --- ![Explanation-Banner](https://i.imgur.com/1b5b4PR.png) Forget other woodcutters. This woodcutter works more smoothly. Unlike other woodcutter datapacks, it doesn't have unnecessary items. It's cleaner and only contains the essentials. For example, there are no unnecessary things like bookshelves. **Why am I not adding them?** Because it's ridiculous to make something that requires books and wood with just wood, so I made this datapack because I couldn't find a datapack that suited me. It's perfect for those who think like me. [**My Other Projects**](https://modrinth.com/user/JacobStar_) --- ## Features Vanilla-style Woodcutters Lightweight, no performance loss ---
